terra.problem: The line about how many words same-size crowds need makes the way Scripture is written the joke.
Saying the people had heard something big adds a detail the passage does not give.
A full tray with no crumbs left behind does not match the action of everyone brought for healing being healed, so the comparison does not click.
It says the apostles were already teaching in the temple courts when they were arrested. Verse 21 places that teaching after their release.
Saying the apostles went 'right back' to the temple courts implies they had been there before their arrest, which the passage does not say.
The reference to an angel changing Papa Dorin's life does not identify the drawer or explain the backstory for a baker who does not know it.
The passage does not call the temple courts the busiest spot in town. 'Back' also implies the apostles had been teaching there before their arrest.
Calling Moses Israel's lawgiver brings in a Bible fact from outside the passage without a reference.
The apostles are before the Sanhedrin, but the passage does not say this scene takes place in the temple courts.
Spreading is not the opposite of failing. Gamaliel's examples drew followers before their movements came to nothing.
Calling it strange for something of human origin to last makes a broad claim beyond Gamaliel's statement about this particular purpose or endeavor.
